lots.working: Keep: lowest close same-item SOLD = $90 hammer (365713, 385815, 384016). $90 / 1.198 = $75.13, round down to $75. Flip: likely resale about $130 (Gowans close-lot median hammer $110 x 1.198 = $132, rounded to $130; no external sold data).
